body:
The one connected controller previously merged into P1's own full keyboard input (WASD/Space/J/K/LShift), so keyboard+pad drove the same fighter and P2 (arrows/RCtrl/Slash/Apostrophe) never saw the pad. Reassigned the pad merge to P2's input block instead -- P1 pure keyboard, P2 keyboard-or-pad. Verified: gcc -fsyntax-only clean, bash scripts/build.sh builds + physics smoke test PASS. Commit 9571293.

⚓ ☃
title: TIPJAR: gamepad now drives Player 2, not Player 1
